messages:
hao.cheng: Heads up — bringing Lumen v1 (q5.0) into staging and seeing weird mixed-script tokenization + bidi scrambling on zh + arabic inputs. Repro is tiny and consistent. Anyone seen something like this before?

anika: Can you paste a minimal repro + the tokenizer/version you used? Also attach the quant config if possible. :eyes:

hao.cheng: Minimal repro below. Running the hosted inference endpoint on staging (model: lumen-v1-q5, tokenizer: lumen-tokenizer-2026-03-01).
```
Input: Translate to Arabic: 今天我们要测试 — مرحبا بالعالم
API: curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/infer -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"lumen-v1-q5","input":"Translate to Arabic: 今天我们要测试 — مرحبا بالعالع"}'
```
Actual (staging q5):
```
"اليوم نحن نريد اختبار —  今 天 我 们 要 测 试"
```
Expected: All CJK sections should be translated or preserved in order; not interleaved/token-split into spaced graphemes inside the Arabic output. Looks like CJK characters are being emitted as spaced subtokens and injected mid-stream.

jules: That looks like tokenization normalization or a detokenization step got swapped. Two guesses: (1) the tokenizer dump used for quant had a different unicode normalization (NFD vs NFKC) or (2) the detok postproc for bidi/script switching was disabled during the quant calibration.

kevin: I ran tokenizer diffs between prod and lumen-tokenizer-2026-03-01: main deltas are U+200C (ZWNJ) handling and a new rule mapping ideographic space (U+3000) -> ascii space. Also noticed "compact_unify" flag set in the q5 build.

triage-bot: nightly-evals/lumen_v1_q5: multilang-detok -> BLEU delta -3.2 vs prod (2026-03-22). Top failing locales: zh (-4.1), ko (-2.9), ar (-3.6). Testset: translate/opus-multiscript-10k.

srini: Quick try: pin the tokenizer to prod:v1 and rerun the quant job (without compact_unify). If that fixes the smoke, we can bisect the tokenizer changes later.

hao.cheng: Trying pin now. Uploading small log excerpt from the failing request: 
```
[2026-03-22T14:02:11Z] request_id=abc123 step=tokenize input_len=27 tokens= [\"Translate\",\" to\",\" Arabic\",\":\",\" \u4eca\",\" \u5929\",\" \u6211\",\" \u4eec\",\" \u8981\",\" \u6d4b\",\" \u8bd5\",\" \u2014\",\" \u0633\",\" \u0639\", ...]
[2026-03-22T14:02:12Z] request_id=abc123 step=generate token_stream= [0x1f4, 0x2a3, 0x00ff, 0x10a2, 0x200c, 0x???]
[2026-03-22T14:02:13Z] request_id=abc123 step=detok status=ok postproc_flags=0x04
[2026-03-22T14:02:13Z] request_id=abc123 result= "اليوم نحن نريد اختبار —  今 天 我 们 要 测 试"
```

anika: Good logs. Please attach the tokenizer.json and the quant config (qconfig.yaml) for the job that produced lumen-tokenizer-2026-03-01. Also include the tokenizer diff output if possible.

ha0.cheng: uploaded artifacts to the thread and filed INF-1429 with the sample set. (typo in handle earlier; that's me)

jules: I'll take INF-1429 and start a bisect on the tokenizer repo. If pinning the tokenizer to prod:v1 fixes it we can short-term whitelist that for staging. I'll also add a smoke that runs a couple of CJK+RTL mixed examples. :thumbsup:

kevin: note — watch out for the quant calibration script we used, it munges merges.json to drop rarely-seen joins which might break multi-script heuristics. I'll run a rerun without calibration optimizations and share results in an hour.

hao.cheng: Thanks all — blocking customer tests until we confirm. Pinging @anika @jules for updates.

jules: update tomorrow AM after bisect. If anyone finds a quick repro patch, drop it here and I'll pick it up.

triage-bot: ticket INF-1429 created by hao.cheng, linked artifacts: tokenizer.json, qconfig.yaml, sample-repro.json

hao.cheng: filed and added the small failing set to the ticket. Appreciate the help! :heart:
